message:
fix(ingress): enforce V2 deadline after signed response verification

Response decoding and signature verification consume the original caller
deadline. Refuse a completed signed response once that deadline expires.

Exercise a real loopback signed response at the final return boundary,
retain an on-time response control, and refuse expired calls before TCP.
Update the exact audited source pin without changing protocol domains
or any service lifetime, resource budget, or qualification verdict.

Fix MU1 source binding after audited verifier updates

Bind the unchanged MU1 research contract to the reviewed current pon_work
source. The native delta preserves the original W1 statement and adds
cooperative task hashing, module exports and a private checked continuation.
Keep all 16 cost cells unknown, all proof obligations open, and HOLD_NO_GO.

The original source mismatch and 16-test failure remain in audit receipts;
the 16 existing contract and negative controls pass after this one-pin fix.

Rebind joint research audit to reviewed current source

The listed 23-file source anchor drifted after reviewed native verifier,
read-only forecast, and confirmation-integrity updates. Compare every pin
to the original Git revision, review the three complete native deltas, and
anchor the current map to the commit containing the MU1 pin repair.

Retain all 18 unknown parameters, 13 open obligations, 16 unproved cost
cells, and HOLD_NO_GO. Keep the independent checker map guard and expand
the existing revision-refusal control to reject the superseded anchor.
Update the matching joint contract, checker and control blobs in the PQ corpus.

fix: bind retained native collector to its pinned source commit

Read and verify the original collector blob under the externally pinned commit and tree without executing it. Preserve current collector evolution and retained evidence. Cover changed current source, absent commits, wrong trees, symlinks, replacement refs and forged current digests.

test: bind gated-root cleanup to its actual native wait status

Keep the original launch error, execution gate, cleanup limits and production status untouched. Require exact owned-root waitid/wait4 agreement. Accept gate EOF exit125 or only a recorded same-birth TERM/KILL from launch-error cleanup before the actual reap. Preserve all other controls and update the one corpus blob pin.

Merge reviewed concurrent source with local deadline and ownership fixes

Reconcile ABFC and 2a by explicit source and evidence dispositions.
Keep the local public_v2 completion deadline check, select the reviewed
immutable PublicPolicy prefix cache and epoch-before-readiness store,
and compose all sixteen owned-collector controls with causal raw status.
Restore four byte-exact metadata files missing from a retained index,
correct current versus historical source labels, and preserve the old
FC39 observations with the withdrawn ordering recommendation explicit.
Original business failures and qualification boundaries remain open.
